title: InvCap
description: Cap the number of items allowed in an inventory
body:
## InvCap
Caps the number of items allowed in an inventory

**Features:**
- Add/Remove any item through config
- Drop items if already in inventory
- Prevent picking up additional items
- Toast messages

**Changelog:**
- 1.0.0
  - Release
- 1.0.1
  - Added toast messages
  - Prevented Picking Up
- 1.0.2
  - Optimized code
  - Changed name


**Config:**
```
item-limits:
  ender_pearl: 16
  totem_of_undying: 2
  golden_apple: 64 
  enchanted_golden_apple: 5
  shield: 0 # Disable
  # Add more
  # Supports more than a stack!
```

Made originally for SteakSMP
